15.name: January 1, 2026
15.overview: The Motor City Machine Guns' Alex Shelley brings his veteran experience to a clash with Los Garza's Angel. Joaquin Wilde of the LWO looks to match speed and creativity with Bravo Americano in a high-flying encounter.

15.name: January 8, 2026
15.overview: The MFT’s Talla Tonga imposes his presence in a test of strength against Apollo Crews. A tag team throwdown pits The War Raiders’ power against the aerial skill of Los Americanos.

15.name: January 15, 2026
15.overview: "The Mad Dragon" Ilja Dragunov turns up the heat against Kit Wilson. Alpha Academy's Otis & Akira Tozowa battle American Made's Creed Brothers.

15.name: January 22, 2026
15.overview: Rey Fenix and Fraxiom's Nathan Frazer take to the sky in a battle between two of WWE's highest flyers. Ireland's own Lyra Valkyria tangles with the powerhouse of American Made, Ivy Nile. American Alpha's Akira Tozawa and "The Aussie Icon" Grayson Waller collide.

15.name: January 29, 2026
15.overview: Kit Wilson looks to put an end to Apollo Crews' "toxic masculinity" in a one-on-one showdown. Alpha Academy's Maxxine Dupri squares off with the powerhouse of American Made, Ivy Nile. The highflying Joaquin Wilde faces Rusev in a battle of contrasting styles.

15.name: February 5, 2026
15.overview: Rusev aims to crush The LWO's Joaquin Wilde. Alpha Academy and American Made collide in tag team throwdown. Los Americanos strive to prove their lucha libre greatness in a battle against Motor City Machine Guns.

15.name: February 12, 2026
15.overview: Dragon Lee aims to silence "The Aussie Icon" Grayson Waller. LWO collide with American Made in a clash of contrasting wrestling styles. Apollo Crews takes on Berto.

15.name: June 4, 2026
15.overview: Jordynne Grace collides with Kiana James in a battle of strength and confidence. The LWO square off with Los Americanos in a heated tag team showdown. Lyra Valkyria meets Ivy Nile in a clash of technique and power.

15.name: June 11, 2026
15.overview: Maxxine Dupri battles Roxanne Perez, Giulia tangles with Jordynne Grace, and NXT's Dorian Van Dux faces Rayo Americano on WWE Main Event.

15.name: June 18, 2026
15.overview: Bayley and Lyra Valkyria take on Kali Armstrong and Layla Diggs, Otis battles Harlem Lewis, and Jordynne Grace collides with Kiana James.

15.name: June 25, 2026
15.overview: Women's Intercontinental Champion Sol Ruca takes on Nattie; Candice LeRae battles Jacy Jayne, and Los Americanos tangles with the LWO on WWE Main Event.

15.name: July 2, 2026
15.overview: Carmelo Hayes battles Axiom, and Dragon Lee takes on Rusev on WWE Main Event.

15.name: July 9, 2026
15.overview: Lizzy Rain's WWE Main Event debut as she takes on Ivy Nile, plus Je'Von Evans takes on Grayson Waller.

15.name: July 16, 2026
15.overview: Thea Hail takes on Ivy Nile, The LWO Battle DarkState, and Matt Cardona contends against Ricky Saints on WWE Main Event.

15.name: July 23, 2026
15.overview: Giulia battles Kiana James, Wendy Choo tackles Ivy Nile, and Sean Legacy and Dorian Van Dux take on American Made on WWE Main Event.

15.name: July 30, 2026
15.overview: WWE Women's Speed Champion Wren Sinclair faces an unstable Lyra Valkyria, Carmelo Hayes battles Ricky Saints, and The LWO take on Harlem Lewis and Harley Riggins on WWE Main Event.

15.name: August 6, 2026
15.overview: Evolve's PJ Vasa takes on Ivy Nile, Axiom faces Ricky Saints, and American Made battles Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno on WWE Main Event.

15.name: August 13, 2026
15.overview: NXT's Jaida Parker collides with Lyra Valkyria, Fraxiom battle Tama and Talla Tonga (with Haku in their corner), and American Made tangle with Uriah Connors and Stacks of Birthright on WWE Main Event.

15.name: August 20, 2026
15.overview: Three matches were scheduled to air but the broadcast ended after one in which Giulia faced Michin.

15.name: August 27, 2026
15.overview: Akira Tozawa takes on Jasper Troy, Wendy Choo battles Maxxine Dupri.

15.name: September 3, 2026
15.overview: Matt Cardona goes one-on-one with Kit Wilson. Fraxiom tangle with AAA Tag Team Champions The War Raiders in a non-title match.

15.name: September 10, 2026
15.overview: Big Cass looks to dominate Brooks Jensen and The LWO face Viktor Zanov and Shido Ash.

15.name: September 17, 2026
15.overview: Joe Hendry battles Ethan Page, Kyoki faces Kit Wilson, and the LWO clash with Alpha Academy on WWE Main Event.

15.name: September 24, 2026
15.overview: Big Cass duke it out with Josh Briggs, AAA Tag Team Champions The Wagner Brothers collide with The LWO and Fraxiom face Aero Star and Laredo Kid on WWE Main Event.

15.name: October 1, 2026
15.overview: Otis takes on NXT's Naraku, Kyoki battles Axiom and Maxxine Dupri tangles with Chantel Monroe on WWE Main Event

15.name: October 8, 2026
15.overview: Shinsuke Nakamura battles The Miz, Big Cass looks to dominate Sean Legacy, and Maxxine Dupri faces Andi Summers on WWE Main Event.

15.name: October 14, 2026
15.overview: Sol Ruca tangles with Lyra Valkyria, Dragon Lee faces Austin Theory, Rey Fenix collides with Kit Wilson, and Nathan Frazer battles Ricky Saints on the debut episode of WWE Main Event on Rumble.

15.name: October 21, 2026
15.overview: The Vision's Austin Theory and Alpha Academy's Otis square-off, The MFTs take on the high-speed Fraxiom, WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green battles Fatal Influence's Lainey Reid, and Sol Ruca tangles with Candice LeRae.

15.name: October 28, 2026
15.overview: The high-speed Fraxiom take on The Miz and Kit Wilson, Damian Priest looks to continue a path of destruction against the War Raiders' Ivar, Los Americanos head to battle against The Judgment Day's JD McDonagh and Dominik Mysterio, and Joe Hendry is live in concert!

overview: WWE Main Event is an American professional wrestling program produced by WWE. Currently, episodes typically consist of two or three prerecorded matches that are filmed before Raw and Smackdown.
title: WWE Main Event
